Home

2026 Mid-Year Meeting

Credential

Issuer
National Writing Project

Description

This microcredential recognizes your active participation in the January Literacy Routines Zoom event, a 90-minute live session designed to bridge the fall and spring online courses. During this collaborative experience, you will engage with the instructional resource for the upcoming Teacher as Researcher module, participate in professional conversation with colleagues, and begin preparing for the analysis of student writing that will take place at the Spring Regroup meeting.

Criteria

To earn this microcredential, participants must:

  • Attend the full 90-minute Zoom session live.

  • Actively participate in the session, including engaging in whole-group and small-group conversations.

This microcredential is awarded based on attendance and participation during the live event and does not require a separate written submission.
